name: awesome-genomic-skills
description: Curated index of agent skills and MCP servers for genomics and bioinformatics from DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, and community projects.
longDescription: GoekeLab's awesome-genomic-skills is the map of the bio agent-skills ecosystem: skill libraries (Google DeepMind science-skills, OpenAI life-science-research, Anthropic life-sciences, AWS Kiro bundle, ClawBio, SciAgent-skills), life-science MCP servers (biomcp, gget-mcp, Seqera, plant-genomics-mcp), and agent benchmarks like BixBench and LAB-Bench. CC0-licensed and maintained by a genomics research lab, it cleanly distinguishes skills from MCP servers. The best single entry point for this whole category.
